progress.acceptedDefinition: Forward frontier plus TARGET_STATISTICS and next run START or same-run COMPLETE driver return; frontier/reports alone do not establish commit.

limits: Only current campaign logs and manifests are measured inputs.
Official engine excludes joinedStaticBindingTime but includes seal/release. Seal duration is a separate overlapping component, not additional engine time.
Relation census is current stored output memberships/annotations, not cumulative work or concrete denotation size. Public census equals combined minus block.
No per-layer NORMAL/DEMAND relation split is logged; outgoing selection may contain eligible NORMAL summaries. Do not label outgoing as DEMAND-layer count.
Target reports, target demand, AP demand edges, and latest accepted report are distinct fields.
Analysed counts nonzero-initial method keys; zero-only actor keys are separate. Demand method keys may include methods absent from current nonzero actors.
Per-method ranks cover only logged bounded methods, usually top24 by steps; shares use that logged subset denominator.
Workload counter c5RowAttempts includes output-program finalizations and native/fallback attempts, not old all-row calls.
No fact-trace completeness, CPU attribution, retained memory saving, unique key count or project speedup follows from these counters.

coverage.methodSelection: Completed run emits top24 loop methods by steps; aborted run emits a different bounded joined-owner sample. These are not global all-work totals.

prepared.pureDuplicateProgramRatio: NOT_DERIVED: accepted no-output occurrences and failed factory prefixes need separate counts.

counterDefinitions.c5PlanOccurrences: K: checked row/member occurrences included in successfully built prepared plans; failed factory prefixes are not necessarily included.
counterDefinitions.c5AcceptedOccurrences: k: accepted entry tickets in successfully built plans; accepted entry-only/no-output occurrences may not produce programs.
counterDefinitions.c5OutputPrograms: s: distinct exact output programs across successfully built plans; not unique across different plan contexts.
counterDefinitions.c5ProgramQueries: Prepared plan intersections, including empty-base answers and queries that later overflow and fall back.
counterDefinitions.c5PacketStreams: Native protected/ordinary stream traversals in the prepared path, not unique packets.
counterDefinitions.c5ScalarEnumerations: Scalar mark/path memberships visited in prepared stream traversals; may include work discarded on overflow.
counterDefinitions.c5ProgramCandidates: Scalar/program candidate pairs visited after output index selection.
counterDefinitions.c5SelectedReferences: Distinct per-program/per-stream selected Conclusions inserted into query-local buckets.
counterDefinitions.c5SelectedReferencePeak: Maximum selected references in one query, not an additive total; may include the overflow-triggering reference.
counterDefinitions.c5BucketFallbacks: Prepared queries whose selected-reference bound is exceeded; native full query recomputes after partial pure work is discarded.
counterDefinitions.c5StreamPacks: Whole-program protected/ordinary stream packing operations, not per-leaf cuts.
counterDefinitions.c5RowAttempts: CHANGED: prepared output-program finalizations plus native/fallback row-packet attempts. Do not compare directly with old all-row call counts.
counterDefinitions.c5PlanFallback*: Factory fallback reason counts, not total native executions through cached negative plans.
counterDefinitions.prePublicationLocalOffers: Actual LocalVar raw-summary gate invocations; distinct from prepared cache entries and later local-boundary tests.
counterDefinitions.prePublicationDeadLocals: Raw-summary gate invocations returning DeadData; repeated invocations are not unique dropped facts.
counterDefinitions.preparedExitEntries: Prepared route cache entries, not raw-summary invocations.
counterDefinitions.preparedExitTargetMasks: Built local target masks; dynamic ActualStarts is still intersected at use.
counterDefinitions.localPublicationLinearPairs: Arithmetic row/input/member all-pairs bound, not proof every prior version executed every native predicate.
counterDefinitions.savedOutputPositions: Positional saved-reader selections; positions sharing a record still retain their ordinals.

limits: This is log/counter evidence, not CPU or a complete fact trace.
Absent counter lines and unlogged methods are unknown, not zero.
End-state gauges, cumulative query counts, scalar memberships and sampled widths have different denominators.
Prepared c5RowAttempts now includes program finalizations; compare the explicit new K/k/s/stream counters instead of old row-call totals.
No unique annotated key count is inferred from event totals or bounded firstBranch samples.

sourceInterpretation.finding: Current binder canonicalizes input.actual and matches full row.original within each popped writer input visit. Static profile therefore supports studying exact owner/full-premise matching and canonical-input reuse, retaining input order/whole query and all native effects.

SpatialCanonicalKt includes canonicalFlowPacket and its new canonicalFlowDataPacket helper, plus aggregate flow/taint basis work. The disjoint canonicalization scope counts a sample/weight once even when both helpers appear. Inclusive helper shares must not be added.

limits: JFR ExecutionSample and async-profiler CPU stacks are sampled stack shares, not wall time or total process CPU.
Inclusive frame percentages overlap. First matching scope wins only in disjoint scope tables.
ObjectAllocationSample weights estimate allocation churn; they are not retained heap or exact allocated bytes.
Process CPU is kernel utime+stime for the analyzer JVM, including native GC/JIT work. Boundary values interpolate roughly 1 s samples; the manifest UTC anchor has 1 s resolution.
STW pauses are wall-time intervals, not GC CPU. Do not subtract them from process CPU or turn sample shares into seconds.
JFR collection sumOfPauses is assigned by collection start; top-level GCPhasePause/gc.log intervals are intersected with windows separately.
A collapsed profile has no event timestamps. A mixed capture cannot be divided into per-run sample shares.
Run marker windows use logged clocks; engine/static-completion splitting also uses logged bindingTime. Partial/end snapshots can omit earlier events.
Cumulative counters, batch/packet events, admitted rows, CPU samples, allocation weights, RSS and retained heap have different units. Callback counts can vary with batching.
Different recordings can contain duplicate events. Never sum cumulative snapshots or overlapping windows.
Disjoint scope priority is supplied explicitly. Use inclusive raw frame counts to compare outer phases with historical classifiers.
Continuous-first reads continuous only when present; end-snapshots are not summed. Missing early events are reported by first/last selected timestamps and resource-window coverage.
Actual static binding is excluded by legacy engineTime. Run START/END marker windows include binding/seal/cleanup; reconstructed binding windows remain approximate, not stage CPU clocks.
No raw captures are deleted or rewritten.
Closed TIMEOUT START/END windows are exact clocks but not completed iterations; completionStatus and separate latest-complete/latest-accepted labels are mandatory.

JFR envelope missing-time bounds are explicit; their intersection is not proof of continuous event retention or uniform sampling. Missing-event intervals are derived for each new recording; no previous-campaign loss interval is reused.
Inclusive relevant frames overlap and are not additive. Disjoint classifier puts canonical and role work before outer observer/binding scopes, unlike earlier campaigns.
Allocation sites are nearest bidi frames and weighted estimates; their weight is not retained heap.
No baseline rerun or real-project diagnostic was performed by this derivation. Quality losses require separate first-loss evidence.
Candidate impact cannot be predicted by adding overlapping inclusive shares or treating an entire sampled phase as avoidable.

GuidanceFrontier.lean.text:
/-
Selected design: keep STAR; retain operational guidance separately from data
coverage. C2 below is the existing imported scalar policy, without overrides.

Scope: finite FULL scalar lists, ordinary nonstatic bases, counted fields,
Empty E, no ZERO data transfer, GROUP/mx, aliases, ND transfer or field budget.
ZERO/ND appear only in the existing source-handoff selector truth table.
Exit labels are opaque complete coordinates: no exit component is recomputed.

This proves local union and image facts once exact paired rows are available.
It does NOT prove rows arrive from point/summary producers or survive their
normalization. Producer-transition, ownership, 39-adapter and global effect
obligations remain OPEN. No assumed arrival invariant closes those gaps.
-/
import RestrictedInitialPolicy

namespace GuidanceFrontier
open ApSpec

abbrev Demand := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand
abbrev Input := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Input
abbrev Mark := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Mark

structure Row where
  query : Demand
  exitLabel : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Exact paired-row union. Lists implement finite set membership; duplicates
and order have no meaning in the image predicates below. This is the guide
algebra, not a data-coverage antichain and not a callback-count theorem. -/
def guideUnion (left right : List Row) : List Row := left ++ right

def containsBy (accept : Row → Bool) : List Row → Bool
  | [] => false
  | row :: rest => accept row || containsBy accept rest

/-- Apply unchanged C2 to each retained query coordinate. -/
def c2Image (rows : List Row) (actual initial : Input) : Bool :=
  containsBy (fun row => decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit row.query actual = some initial)) rows

/-- Paired admission image: C2 emits an initial and keeps that same row's
complete opaque exit label. Production C5 restriction, canStoreInitial and
budget are not modeled. containsBy can later accept an actual C5-row predicate. -/
def pairedAdmissionImage (rows : List Row) (actual initial : Input) (exitLabel : Nat) : Bool :=
  containsBy (fun row =>
    decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit row.query actual = some initial) &&
      Nat.beq row.exitLabel exitLabel) rows

theorem contains_guide_union (accept : Row → Bool) (left right : List Row) :
    containsBy accept (guideUnion left right) =
      (containsBy accept left || containsBy accept right) := by
  induction left with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons row rest ih =>
    simpa only [guideUnion, List.cons_append, containsBy, Bool.or_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun value => accept row || value) ih

theorem guide_union_both_orders (accept : Row → Bool) (left right : List Row) :
    containsBy accept (guideUnion left right) =
      containsBy accept (guideUnion right left) := by
  rw [contains_guide_union, contains_guide_union]
  exact Bool.or_comm _ _

theorem c2_image_union (left right : List Row) (actual initial : Input) :
    c2Image (guideUnion left right) actual initial =
      (c2Image left actual initial || c2Image right actual initial) :=
  contains_guide_union _ left right

theorem paired_admission_image_union (left right : List Row) (actual initial : Input)
    (label : Nat) :
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion left right) actual initial label =
      (pairedAdmissionImage left actual initial label || pairedAdmissionImage right actual initial label) :=
  contains_guide_union _ left right

theorem paired_admission_image_both_orders (left right : List Row) (actual initial : Input)
    (label : Nat) :
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion left right) actual initial label =
      pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion right left) actual initial label :=
  guide_union_both_orders _ left right

/-- Separate DATA algebra. This local ANY-prefix coverage recognizer is used
only to exhibit loss; it does not claim to model all native canonicalization. -/
def queryCovers (broad narrow : Demand) : Bool :=
  decide (broad.base = narrow.base) && decide (broad.mark = narrow.mark) &&
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq broad.shape .any &&
    (dropPrefix broad.path narrow.path).isSome

def dataCovers (broad narrow : Row) : Bool :=
  Nat.beq broad.exitLabel narrow.exitLabel && queryCovers broad.query narrow.query

def dataInsert (row : Row) (rows : List Row) : List Row :=
  if rows.any (fun old => dataCovers old row) then rows
  else row :: rows.filter (fun old => !(dataCovers row old))

def p : Nat := 1
def f : Acc := 7
def T : Mark := .full 11
def d0 : Demand := ⟨p, [], .any, .flow⟩
def d1 : Demand := ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow⟩
def rootRow : Row := ⟨d0, 17⟩
def childRow : Row := ⟨d1, 17⟩
def actualChildMust : Input := ⟨p, [f], .any, T, true⟩
def childStarFlow : Input := ⟨p, [f], .star, .flow, false⟩
def childMustFlow : Input := ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow, true⟩

def anyQuerySupports (query : Demand) (location : List Acc) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq query.shape .any &&
    (dropPrefix query.path location).isSome

theorem denotational_root_ANY_covers_child_ANY (location : List Acc) :
    anyQuerySupports d1 location = true → anyQuerySupports d0 location = true := by
  intro _
  rfl

theorem unchanged_C2_has_distinct_root_child_images :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d0 actualChildMust = some childStarFlow ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d1 actualChildMust = some childMustFlow ∧
    childStarFlow ≠ childMustFlow := by decide

theorem guide_pair_keeps_both_images_in_both_orders :
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]) actualChildMust childStarFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]) actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [childRow] [rootRow]) actualChildMust childStarFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [childRow] [rootRow]) actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true := by decide

theorem DATA_prefix_removal_discards_child_in_both_orders :
    dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow []) = [rootRow] ∧
    dataInsert rootRow (dataInsert childRow []) = [rootRow] := by decide

theorem DATA_coverage_is_not_C2_image_equivalence :
    queryCovers d0 d1 = true ∧
    c2Image [rootRow] actualChildMust childMustFlow = false ∧
    c2Image (guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]) actualChildMust childMustFlow = true := by decide

/-- A later exact-union store can retain what it receives, but cannot recover
this missing coordinate from a producer that already emitted only rootRow.
This is a countermodel, not a claim about which native producer owns the loss. -/
theorem late_store_retention_cannot_recover_discarded_child :
    guideUnion (dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow [])) [] = [rootRow] ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion (dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow [])) [])
      actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = false := by decide

theorem exact_pairing_does_not_cross_exit_labels :
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childStarFlow 41 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childMustFlow 42 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childStarFlow 42 = false ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childMustFlow 41 = false := by decide

inductive Layer where | normal | demand
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Direction where | forward | backward
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Origin where | initial (isZero : Bool) | nd
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Existing source-handoff selection, not a new all-NORMAL export rule. -/
def selectedForHandoff : Layer → Direction → Origin → Bool
  | .demand, _, _ => true
  | .normal, _, .nd => true
  | .normal, .backward, .initial true => true
  | _, _, _ => false

theorem source_handoff_selector_table :
    selectedForHandoff .demand .forward (.initial false) = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .demand .backward (.initial false) = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .forward .nd = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .backward .nd = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .backward (.initial true) = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .forward (.initial true) = false ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .forward (.initial false) = false ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .backward (.initial false) = false := by decide

/-- Empty-E scalar part of guidancePattern: MUST loses its must flag, keeps
its ANY geometry, and other heads stay themselves. No emitter is changed. -/
def guidanceHead (actual : Input) : Demand :=
  ⟨actual.base, actual.path, actual.shape, actual.mark⟩

theorem guidance_MUST_ANY_and_other_heads :
    guidanceHead actualChildMust = ⟨p, [f], .any, T⟩ ∧
    guidanceHead ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ = ⟨p, [f], .star, T⟩ ∧
    guidanceHead ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ = ⟨p, [f], .exact, T⟩ := by decide

/-- Same point, concrete MAY versus EXACT guidance. ANY geometry may cover
EXACT geometry while selecting a different current C2 initial. This shows why
guide retention must inspect all heads, not just proper-prefix ANY pairs. -/
def mayQuery : Demand := ⟨p, [], .any, T⟩
def exactQuery : Demand := ⟨p, [], .exact, T⟩
def actualRootMay : Input := ⟨p, [], .any, T, false⟩
def rootExact : Input := ⟨p, [], .exact, T, false⟩

theorem same_point_MAY_EXACT_guide_countercell :
    queryCovers mayQuery exactQuery = true ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit mayQuery actualRootMay = some actualRootMay ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit exactQuery actualRootMay = some rootExact ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨mayQuery, 17⟩] actualRootMay rootExact 17 = false ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨mayQuery, 17⟩, ⟨exactQuery, 17⟩] actualRootMay rootExact 17 = true := by decide

/-- A concrete row-union witness that root can evaluate without choice. -/
def retainedRows : List Row := guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]

theorem retained_rows_are_an_executable_witness :
    retainedRows = [rootRow, childRow] ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage retainedRows actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true := by decide

#eval retainedRows
#eval (pairedAdmissionImage retainedRows actualChildMust childMustFlow 17)
#print axioms contains_guide_union
#print axioms guide_union_both_orders
#print axioms c2_image_union
#print axioms paired_admission_image_union
#print axioms paired_admission_image_both_orders
#print axioms denotational_root_ANY_covers_child_ANY
#print axioms unchanged_C2_has_distinct_root_child_images
#print axioms guide_pair_keeps_both_images_in_both_orders
#print axioms DATA_prefix_removal_discards_child_in_both_orders
#print axioms DATA_coverage_is_not_C2_image_equivalence
#print axioms late_store_retention_cannot_recover_discarded_child
#print axioms exact_pairing_does_not_cross_exit_labels
#print axioms source_handoff_selector_table
#print axioms guidance_MUST_ANY_and_other_heads
#print axioms same_point_MAY_EXACT_guide_countercell
#print axioms retained_rows_are_an_executable_witness

end GuidanceFrontier

ProducerGuidance.lean.text:
/-
Local producer algebra for the selected demand-guidance design.
No current C2 policy is changed. No native producer equivalence is asserted.

Finite scope: FLOW/DEMAND/ANY operational coordinates, ordinary bases, Empty E,
counted paths, FULL marks from a two-atom table. Headers still carry kind, base,
layer, tail, E and mx. Admitted input coordinates supply an opaque complete exit
label. No premise or admission fact is synthesized by handoff.

Raw states are executable characteristic views of finite coordinate packets.
Function equality below means coordinate membership equality, not packet order,
duplicate multiplicity, native DAG layout, queue effects or callback counts.
Runtime mark requests and every producer/adapter transition remain OPEN.
-/
import GuidanceFrontier

namespace ProducerGuidance
open ApSpec GuidanceFrontier

inductive Kind where | flow | taint | reach
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Tail where | exact | star | any | must
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Finite FULL-only exclusion table. No group/catalog normalization is modeled. -/
structure Mx where
  tExcluded : Bool
  uExcluded : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Header where
  kind : Kind
  base : Nat
  layer : GuidanceFrontier.Layer
  tail : Tail
  exclusion : Excl
  mx : Mx
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Coordinate where
  header : Header
  path : List Acc
  exitLabel : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

abbrev RawState := Coordinate → Bool

def emptyState : RawState := fun _ => false
def rawView : List Coordinate → RawState
  | [] => emptyState
  | head :: rest => fun coordinate => decide (coordinate = head) || rawView rest coordinate

def rawAdd (old incoming : RawState) : RawState :=
  fun coordinate => old coordinate || incoming coordinate

def rawDelta (old incoming : RawState) : RawState :=
  fun coordinate => incoming coordinate && !(old coordinate)

theorem raw_view_append (left right : List Coordinate) :
    rawView (left ++ right) = rawAdd (rawView left) (rawView right) := by
  funext coordinate
  induction left with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head rest ih =>
    simpa only [List.cons_append, rawView, rawAdd, Bool.or_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun value => decide (coordinate = head) || value) ih

theorem raw_add_preserves_old (old incoming : RawState) (coordinate : Coordinate)
    (present : old coordinate = true) : rawAdd old incoming coordinate = true := by
  simp [rawAdd, present]

theorem raw_add_preserves_incoming (old incoming : RawState) (coordinate : Coordinate)
    (present : incoming coordinate = true) : rawAdd old incoming coordinate = true := by
  simp [rawAdd, present]

theorem raw_delta_is_exact_coordinate_freshness (old incoming : RawState)
    (coordinate : Coordinate) :
    rawDelta old incoming coordinate = true ↔
      incoming coordinate = true ∧ old coordinate = false := by
  cases hOld : old coordinate <;> cases hNew : incoming coordinate <;>
    simp [rawDelta, hOld, hNew]

theorem exact_duplicate_has_no_delta (state : RawState) :
    rawDelta state state = emptyState := by
  funext coordinate
  cases h : state coordinate <;> simp [rawDelta, emptyState, h]

theorem raw_add_is_idempotent (state : RawState) : rawAdd state state = state := by
  funext coordinate
  cases h : state coordinate <;> simp [rawAdd, h]

theorem raw_add_is_order_independent (left right : RawState) :
    rawAdd left right = rawAdd right left := by
  funext coordinate
  exact Bool.or_comm _ _

theorem delta_reconstructs_added_memberships (old incoming : RawState) :
    rawAdd old (rawDelta old incoming) = rawAdd old incoming := by
  funext coordinate
  cases hOld : old coordinate <;> cases hNew : incoming coordinate <;>
    simp [rawAdd, rawDelta, hOld, hNew]

def mxEmpty : Mx := ⟨false, false⟩
def mxT : Mx := ⟨true, false⟩
def selectedHeader : Header := ⟨.flow, p, .demand, .any, Excl.empty, mxEmpty⟩
def rootCoordinate : Coordinate := ⟨selectedHeader, [], 17⟩
def childCoordinate : Coordinate := ⟨selectedHeader, [f], 17⟩
def rootState : RawState := rawView [rootCoordinate]
def childState : RawState := rawView [childCoordinate]

theorem root_first_child_is_fresh :
    rawDelta rootState childState childCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd rootState childState rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd rootState childState childCoordinate = true := by decide

theorem child_first_root_is_fresh :
    rawDelta childState rootState rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd childState rootState rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd childState rootState childCoordinate = true := by decide

theorem cold_packet_preserves_both_coordinates :
    rawDelta emptyState (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]) rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawDelta emptyState (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]) childCoordinate = true ∧
    rawDelta (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]) childCoordinate = false := by decide

def withMx (coordinate : Coordinate) (mx : Mx) : Coordinate :=
  { coordinate with header := { coordinate.header with mx := mx } }

theorem full_header_mx_path_and_exit_are_coordinates :
    rawView [rootCoordinate] (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with layer := .normal } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with tail := .star } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with exclusion := .set [f] } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with base := p + 1 } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with kind := .taint } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] childCoordinate = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with exitLabel := 18 } = false := by decide

theorem DATA_coverage_and_GUIDE_freshness_are_different :
    queryCovers d0 d1 = true ∧
    dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow []) = [rootRow] ∧
    rawDelta rootState childState childCoordinate = true := by decide

/-- Projection of already supplied eligible rows. FLOW mark exclusions are
dropped by guidancePattern. This local projection does not validate admission,
create exit coordinates, evaluate C5, or prove a native producer reaches here. -/
def handoff (coordinate : Coordinate) : Option Row :=
  let header := coordinate.header
  if header.kind = .flow ∧ header.layer = .demand ∧ header.tail = .any ∧
      header.exclusion = Excl.empty then
    some ⟨⟨header.base, coordinate.path, .any, .flow⟩, coordinate.exitLabel⟩
  else none

def handoffRows (packet : List Coordinate) : List Row := packet.filterMap handoff

def rawObservation (accept : Row → Bool) : List Coordinate → Bool
  | [] => false
  | coordinate :: rest =>
    (match handoff coordinate with | none => false | some row => accept row) ||
      rawObservation accept rest

theorem handoff_preserves_exact_rows_for_any_observation
    (accept : Row → Bool) (packet : List Coordinate) :
    containsBy accept (handoffRows packet) = rawObservation accept packet := by
  induction packet with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons coordinate rest ih =>
    cases h : handoff coordinate with
    | none => simpa [handoffRows, List.filterMap_cons, h, rawObservation, containsBy] using ih
    | some row =>
      simpa only [handoffRows, List.filterMap_cons, h, rawObservation, containsBy] using
        congrArg (fun value => accept row || value) ih

theorem handoff_paired_admission_image_equivalence
    (packet : List Coordinate) (actual initial : Input) (label : Nat) :
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows packet) actual initial label =
      rawObservation (fun row =>
        decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit row.query actual = some initial) &&
          Nat.beq row.exitLabel label) packet :=
  handoff_preserves_exact_rows_for_any_observation _ packet

theorem handoff_root_child_both_orders :
    handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate] = [rootRow, childRow] ∧
    handoffRows [childCoordinate, rootCoordinate] = [childRow, rootRow] := by decide

theorem current_STAR_policy_and_child_MUST_image_are_unchanged :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d0 actualChildMust = some childStarFlow ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d1 actualChildMust = some childMustFlow ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      actualChildMust childStarFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [childCoordinate, rootCoordinate])
      actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true := by decide

/-- Retaining the same-head guide also exposes the existing abstract EXACT
cell. This is another scalar image, not a new emitter or layer policy. -/
theorem retained_child_keeps_existing_exact_FLOW_image :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d0 ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ = some childStarFlow ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d1 ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .exact, .flow, false⟩ ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ ⟨p, [f], .exact, .flow, false⟩ 17 = true := by decide

theorem handoff_projection_drops_mx (coordinate : Coordinate) (mx : Mx) :
    handoff (withMx coordinate mx) = handoff coordinate := rfl

/-- Intersection of excluded atoms is union of admitted FULL atoms. -/
def mxJoinAdmitted (left right : Mx) : Mx :=
  ⟨left.tExcluded && right.tExcluded, left.uExcluded && right.uExcluded⟩

theorem same_head_mx_union_only_after_projection
    (coordinate : Coordinate) (left right : Mx) (accept : Row → Bool) :
    rawObservation accept [withMx coordinate left, withMx coordinate right] =
      rawObservation accept [withMx coordinate (mxJoinAdmitted left right)] := by
  simp only [rawObservation, handoff_projection_drops_mx]
  cases handoff coordinate <;> simp

def requestT (coordinate : Coordinate) : Bool := !(coordinate.header.mx.tExcluded)

def requestU (coordinate : Coordinate) : Bool := !(coordinate.header.mx.uExcluded)

/-- Existing cofinite union preserves the union of requests at this exact head.
This does not authorize prefix pruning or infer equivalence from projection. -/
theorem same_head_mx_intersection_preserves_T_request_union
    (coordinate : Coordinate) (left right : Mx) :
    requestT (withMx coordinate (mxJoinAdmitted left right)) =
      (requestT (withMx coordinate left) || requestT (withMx coordinate right)) := by
  cases hl : left.tExcluded <;> cases hr : right.tExcluded <;>
    simp [requestT, withMx, mxJoinAdmitted, hl, hr]

theorem same_head_mx_intersection_preserves_U_request_union
    (coordinate : Coordinate) (left right : Mx) :
    requestU (withMx coordinate (mxJoinAdmitted left right)) =
      (requestU (withMx coordinate left) || requestU (withMx coordinate right)) := by
  cases hl : left.uExcluded <;> cases hr : right.uExcluded <;>
    simp [requestU, withMx, mxJoinAdmitted, hl, hr]

theorem same_mx_projection_does_not_prove_runtime_request_equivalence :
    handoff (withMx rootCoordinate mxEmpty) = handoff (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) ∧
    requestT (withMx rootCoordinate mxEmpty) = true ∧
    requestT (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) = false ∧
    rawDelta rootState (rawView [withMx rootCoordinate mxT])
      (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) = true := by decide

#eval handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]
#eval rawDelta rootState childState childCoordinate

#print axioms raw_add_preserves_incoming

#print axioms exact_duplicate_has_no_delta
#print axioms raw_add_is_idempotent
#print axioms raw_add_is_order_independent
#print axioms delta_reconstructs_added_memberships
#print axioms root_first_child_is_fresh
#print axioms child_first_root_is_fresh
#print axioms cold_packet_preserves_both_coordinates
#print axioms full_header_mx_path_and_exit_are_coordinates
#print axioms DATA_coverage_and_GUIDE_freshness_are_different
#print axioms handoff_preserves_exact_rows_for_any_observation
#print axioms handoff_paired_admission_image_equivalence
#print axioms handoff_root_child_both_orders
#print axioms current_STAR_policy_and_child_MUST_image_are_unchanged
#print axioms retained_child_keeps_existing_exact_FLOW_image
#print axioms handoff_projection_drops_mx
#print axioms same_head_mx_union_only_after_projection
#print axioms same_head_mx_intersection_preserves_T_request_union

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the finite guidance model against the unchanged scalar C2 model."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LEAN_ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
BASE = LEAN_ROOT / 'proposals/initial-emission/RestrictedInitialPolicy.lean'
MODEL = HERE / 'GuidanceFrontier.lean'
PRODUCER = HERE / 'ProducerGuidance.lean'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    modules = []
    for path, count in ((MODEL, 16), (PRODUCER, 23)):
        model = path.read_text()
        assert not re.search(r'^\s*(?:axiom|opaque|noncomputable)\b', model, re.M)
        assert not re.search(r'\b(?:sorry|admit|Classical)\b', re.sub(r'/\-.*?\-/', '', model, flags=re.S))
        names = re.findall(r'^theorem (\w+)', model, re.M)
        printed = re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\w+)', model, re.M)
        assert len(names) == count and names == printed
        modules.append({'file': path.name, 'sha256': sha(path), 'theorems': count})
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='guidance-frontier-') as temporary:
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['LEAN_PATH'] = temporary + os.pathsep + env.get('LEAN_PATH', '')
        commands = [
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '-M2048', '-o', str(Path(temporary) / 'RestrictedInitialPolicy.olean'), str(BASE)],
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '-M2048', '-o', str(Path(temporary) / 'GuidanceFrontier.olean'), str(MODEL)],
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '-M2048', str(PRODUCER)],
        ]
        outputs = []
        for command in commands:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=LEAN_ROOT, env=env,
                                    text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError(result.stdout)
            assert 'error:' not in result.stdout and 'sorryAx' not in result.stdout
            outputs.append(result.stdout)
    all_output = '\n'.join(outputs)
    for dependencies in re.findall(r'depends on axioms:\s*\[([^]]*)\]', all_output, re.S):
        assert set(dependencies.replace('\n', '').replace(' ', '').split(',')) <= {'propext', 'Quot.sound'}
    audit = [line for output in outputs[1:] for line in output.splitlines()
             if line.startswith(("'GuidanceFrontier.", "'ProducerGuidance."))]
    total = sum(module['theorems'] for module in modules)
    assert len(audit) == total
    receipt = {
        'state': 'PASS', 'model': MODEL.name, 'modelSha256': sha(MODEL),
        'base': str(BASE.relative_to(LEAN_ROOT)), 'baseSha256': sha(BASE),
        'leanToolchain': (LEAN_ROOT / 'lean-toolchain').read_text().strip(),
        'theorems': total, 'modules': modules, 'axiomAudit': audit,
        'allowedFoundationAxioms': ['propext', 'Quot.sound'],
        'scope': 'finite C2 images, coordinate add/delta, exact paired-label handoff and same-head mx request union; unchanged scalar emit',
        'notProved': ['producer retention before normalization', 'production C5 restriction and budgets',
                      'role transitions and engine adapters', 'whole-engine effect or final Conductor recovery'],
    }
    encoded = json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n'
    if args.output:
        args.output.write_text(encoded)
    print(encoded, end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

README.md.text:
# Demand guidance retention: finite model

Selected behavior: keep STAR and repair demand guidance. The model imports the
existing scalar C2 model without changes. It does not use the rejected
first-field MUST emitter.

Run from the repository root:

```bash
python3 spec/lean/proposals/demand-guidance-retention-20261106/check.py
```

The checker compiles the existing scalar model into a temporary directory,
then checks this model. It checks every printed axiom dependency. It permits
only the existing constructive foundations `propext` and `Quot.sound`. It
does not write to `formal/` or change the scalar model.

The first 16 lemmas prove finite C2-image and paired-label properties. Exact row
union keeps root and child demand positions in either arrival order. Data
prefix removal can lose the child's C2 image. The model also checks the
existing handoff selector, MUST-to-ANY guidance projection, and a same-point
concrete MAY/EXACT counterexample. Exit labels are complete opaque identities.
The model cannot borrow an exit from a different row.

`ProducerGuidance.lean` adds 23 lemmas for exact coordinate add/delta,
freshness, duplicates, both arrival orders, and the handoff of already supplied
paired coordinates. It also checks the existing same-head mx intersection:
the allowed T/U request set is the union of its inputs in the finite FULL
table. A separate counterexample shows why equal projected demand rows alone
do not prove equal runtime requests. The same-head exact-input cell is checked
too: its existing EXACT/FLOW initial can appear beside the parent's STAR/FLOW
initial. The checker runs all 39 lemmas.

The scope is FULL scalar facts, ordinary nonstatic bases, counted fields,
empty field exclusions, and finite lists. No production C5 restriction,
field-budget cut, alias transfer, static flow, ND transfer, or ZERO transfer
is proved. ZERO and ND occur only in the handoff selector table.

These proofs start with available exact rows. They do not prove that all
producer paths retain those rows before publication. The late-store example
shows why that distinction matters. Role transitions, engine adapters, and
the required source/sink effects remain open. These local lemmas do not prove
final Conductor recovery or whole-engine correctness.

The [design draft](../../../../docs/design/bidirectional-demand-guidance-retention-implementation-20261106.md)
and [complete local Conductor snapshot](../../../../docs/reports/bidirectional-conductor-must-demand-snapshot-20261106.md)
state the implementation and evidence limits.

unchangedScalarModel.text:
/-
  Restricted initial policy: FULL scalar, ordinary nonstatic bases, Empty E.
  Every modeled accessor is a counted field. Static anchors, ZERO, GROUP,
  mark exclusions and field exclusions require separate adapters/proofs.

  MUST is an explicit Boolean independent of an edge layer. Demand has no
  MUST tail. FLOW metadata is accepted only by a FLOW demand; it cannot
  supply a concrete full mark. Such metadata also permits structural image
  queries without inventing a concrete caller input.

  Historical policy below: precise STAR/EXACT demand emits only EXACT at its
  own path; a proper descendant does not apply. The selected DemandStarPolicy
  namespace at the end supersedes only the STAR proper-descendant cell.
  ANY demand resolves at most one new
  field, with the terminal concrete EXACT exception. Same-prefix supplied
  STAR emits nothing. Ancestor STAR for ANY demand also emits nothing:
  this last row is the stated inferred no-ANY/no-refinement interpretation.
  Ancestor ANY/MUST descends to the ANY demand path and retains its tail.

  No application/normal-record repair or abstract-tail transfer is selected
  in this file. It defines admission and proves its structural image.
-/
import ApSpec.CorrelatedConcreteImplementation

namespace RestrictedInitialPolicy
open ApSpec

inductive Shape where
  | exact | star | any
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Mark where
  | flow | full (id : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def shapeEq : Shape → Shape → Bool
  | .exact, .exact | .star, .star | .any, .any => true
  | _, _ => false

structure Demand where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  shape : Shape
  mark : Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  shape : Shape
  mark : Mark
  must : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def fullMark : Mark → Bool
  | .full _ => true
  | .flow => false

def acceptsMark (required supplied : Mark) : Bool :=
  match required, supplied with
  | .flow, _ => true
  | .full t, .full u => Nat.beq t u
  | .full _, .flow => false

def validInput (a : Input) : Bool := !a.must || shapeEq a.shape .any

inductive Template where
  | rootExact
  | rootAny (must : Bool)
  | childStar (field : Acc)
  | childExact (field : Acc)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def render (d : Demand) : Template → Input
  | .rootExact => ⟨d.base, d.path, .exact, d.mark, false⟩
  | .rootAny must => ⟨d.base, d.path, .any, d.mark, must⟩
  | .childStar f => ⟨d.base, d.path ++ [f], .star, d.mark, false⟩
  | .childExact f => ⟨d.base, d.path ++ [f], .exact, d.mark, false⟩

def validTemplate (d : Demand) : Template → Bool
  | .rootExact => true
  | .rootAny _ | .childStar _ => shapeEq d.shape .any
  | .childExact _ => shapeEq d.shape .any && fullMark d.mark

def rawTemplate (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Template :=
  if validInput a && Nat.beq d.base a.base && acceptsMark d.mark a.mark then
    match d.shape, relate d.path a.path with
    | .any, .below [] =>
      match a.shape with
      | .exact => some .rootExact
      | .any => some (.rootAny a.must)
      | .star => none
    | .any, .below (f :: rest) =>
      if fullMark d.mark && shapeEq a.shape .exact && rest.isEmpty then
        some (.childExact f)
      else some (.childStar f)
    | .any, .above _ => if shapeEq a.shape .any then some (.rootAny a.must) else none
    | .any, .apart => none
    | _, .below [] => some .rootExact
    | _, .below (_ :: _) => none
    | _, .above _ => if shapeEq a.shape .exact then none else some .rootExact
    | _, .apart => none
  else none

/-- The explicit template validity check is a finite domain check, not an
    additional matching policy. rawTemplate's selected cells render these
    canonical templates only. -/
def selectTemplate (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Template :=
  match rawTemplate d a with
  | none => none
  | some t => if validTemplate d t then some t else none

def emit (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Input :=
  match selectTemplate d a with
  | none => none
  | some t => some (render d t)

theorem mark_accepts_itself (m : Mark) : acceptsMark m m = true := by
  cases m with
  | flow => rfl
  | full t => exact Nat.beq_refl t

theorem template_is_its_own_emission (d : Demand) (t : Template)
    (valid : validTemplate d t = true) :
    emit d (render d t) = some (render d t) := by
  have self : dropPrefix d.path d.path = some [] :=
    ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' d.path
  cases d with
  | mk base path shape mark =>
    cases t with
    | rootExact =>
      cases shape <;> cases mark <;>
        simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
          relate, self, validTemplate, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true,
          shapeEq, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or]
    | rootAny must =>
      cases shape <;> simp [validTemplate, shapeEq] at valid
      cases mark <;>
        simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
          relate, self, validTemplate, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true, Bool.or_true, shapeEq]
    | childStar f =>
      have hpath : dropPrefix path (path ++ [f]) = some [f] :=
        CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
      cases shape <;> simp [validTemplate, shapeEq] at valid
      cases mark <;>
        simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
          relate, hpath, validTemplate, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true, fullMark,
          shapeEq, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    | childExact f =>
      have hpath : dropPrefix path (path ++ [f]) = some [f] :=
        CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
      cases shape <;> simp [validTemplate, shapeEq] at valid
      cases mark <;> simp [fullMark] at valid
      simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
        relate, hpath, validTemplate, fullMark, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true,
        shapeEq, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or, List.isEmpty_nil]

theorem selected_template_is_valid (d : Demand) (a : Input) (t : Template)
    (h : selectTemplate d a = some t) : validTemplate d t = true := by
  unfold selectTemplate at h
  cases hr : rawTemplate d a with
  | none => simp only [hr] at h; cases h
  | some candidate =>
    rw [hr] at h
    cases hv : validTemplate d candidate with
    | false => simp only [hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h; cases h
    | true =>
      simp only [hv, if_true, Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      exact hv

/-- Projection law for every emitted initial, not just the finite examples.
    This law is established from the canonical template constructors. -/
theorem emission_is_idempotent (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (h : emit d actual = some initial) : emit d initial = some initial := by
  cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
  | none => simp only [emit, hs] at h; cases h
  | some t =>
    simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact template_is_its_own_emission d t (selected_template_is_valid d actual t hs)

def CanEmit (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Prop :=
  ∃ actual, emit d actual = some initial

theorem emittable_iff_canonical_template (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    CanEmit d initial ↔ ∃ t, validTemplate d t = true ∧ render d t = initial := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨actual, emitted⟩
    cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
    | none => simp only [emit, hs] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some t =>
      simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at emitted
      exact ⟨t, selected_template_is_valid d actual t hs, emitted⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, valid, same⟩
    rw [← same]
    exact ⟨render d t, template_is_its_own_emission d t valid⟩

theorem emittable_iff_self_projection (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    CanEmit d initial ↔ emit d initial = some initial :=
  ⟨fun ⟨actual, h⟩ => emission_is_idempotent d actual initial h,
   fun h => ⟨initial, h⟩⟩

/-- Self-projection is complete here because idempotence was proved for the
    new total policy. It was not valid for the earlier partial policy. -/
def canEmit (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  if emit d initial = some initial then true else false

theorem image_classifier_sound_and_complete (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    canEmit d initial = true ↔ CanEmit d initial := by
  unfold canEmit
  by_cases h : emit d initial = some initial
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨initial, h⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  · rw [if_neg h]
    constructor
    · intro impossible; cases impossible
    · intro emitted
      exact False.elim (h ((emittable_iff_self_projection d initial).mp emitted))

def entryMeet (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Option Input :=
  if canEmit d initial then some initial else none

theorem entry_intersection_exactly_matches_emitter_image (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    entryMeet d initial = some initial ↔ CanEmit d initial := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hc : canEmit d initial with
    | false => simp only [entryMeet, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h; cases h
    | true => exact (image_classifier_sound_and_complete d initial).mp hc
  · intro h
    have hc := (image_classifier_sound_and_complete d initial).mpr h
    simp only [entryMeet, hc, if_true]

theorem emitted_mark_is_demand_mark (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (h : emit d actual = some initial) : initial.mark = d.mark := by
  cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
  | none => simp only [emit, hs] at h; cases h
  | some t =>
    simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    cases t <;> rfl

theorem emitted_input_has_valid_must_flag (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (h : emit d actual = some initial) : validInput initial = true := by
  cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
  | none => simp only [emit, hs] at h; cases h
  | some t =>
    simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    cases t <;> simp only [validInput, render, shapeEq, Bool.or_true] <;> rfl

theorem different_full_marks_never_emit (db ab u t : Nat) (dp ap : List Acc)
    (ds ashape : Shape) (certainty : Bool) (different : u ≠ t) :
    emit ⟨db, dp, ds, .full u⟩ ⟨ab, ap, ashape, .full t, certainty⟩ = none := by
  have mismatch : Nat.beq u t = false := by
    cases hb : Nat.beq u t with
    | false => rfl
    | true => exact False.elim (different (Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true hb))
  simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, acceptsMark, mismatch,
    Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

def p : Nat := 1
def f : Acc := 7
def g : Acc := 8
def T : Mark := .full 1
def anyD : Demand := ⟨p, [], .any, T⟩
def preciseD : Demand := ⟨p, [f], .star, T⟩

theorem user_pinned_cells :
    emit preciseD ⟨p, [f, g], .exact, T, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit preciseD ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ ∧
    emit anyD ⟨p, [], .star, T, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow⟩ ⟨p, [], .any, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow, false⟩ := by decide

theorem any_demand_one_step_cells :
    emit anyD ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ ∧
    emit anyD ⟨p, [f, g], .exact, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ ∧
    emit anyD ⟨p, [f, g], .any, T, true⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ ∧
    emit anyD ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ := by decide

theorem same_prefix_and_ancestor_cells :
    emit ⟨p, [], .any, .flow⟩ ⟨p, [], .exact, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [], .exact, .flow, false⟩ ∧
    emit ⟨p, [], .any, .flow⟩ ⟨p, [], .any, T, true⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [], .any, .flow, true⟩ ∧
    emit ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow⟩ ⟨p, [], .any, T, true⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow, true⟩ ∧
    emit ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow⟩ ⟨p, [], .star, T, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit ⟨p, [f], .star, .flow⟩ ⟨p, [], .star, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .exact, .flow, false⟩ := by decide

theorem image_false_positives_are_rejected :
    canEmit anyD ⟨p, [], .star, T, false⟩ = false ∧
    canEmit anyD ⟨p, [f, g], .exact, T, false⟩ = false ∧
    canEmit anyD ⟨p, [f], .any, T, false⟩ = false ∧
    canEmit anyD ⟨p, [f], .any, T, true⟩ = false ∧
    canEmit preciseD ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ = false ∧
    canEmit anyD ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ = true := by decide

theorem failed_matches_do_not_emit :
    emit anyD ⟨p, [f], .exact, .full 2, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit anyD ⟨p, [f], .exact, .flow, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit anyD ⟨2, [], .any, T, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit ⟨p, [f], .any, T⟩ ⟨p, [g], .exact, T, false⟩ = none ∧
    emit ⟨p, [f], .any, T⟩ ⟨p, [], .exact, T, false⟩ = none := by decide

def toAp (initial : Input) : PFact :=
  ⟨initial.base, initial.path,
    (match initial.shape with | .exact => .exact | .star => .star Excl.empty | .any => .any),
    (match initial.mark with | .flow => .star | .full t => .conc t)⟩

    (ApSpec.Run1CorrelatedConcreteInitials.selectedStart

  !canEmit anyD ⟨p, [f, g], .exact, T, false⟩ &&

/-
  Closed finite trace for the proposed EXACT/FLOW domain. All nonzero boundary
  inputs below come from the declared source, sink seeds, bindings or selected
  emission; the helper exact record is not assumed present.

  main: source(q.f.h); sinkAny(q.f.h); sinkExact(H(q));
        pair=W(q); sinkExact(pair.a); sinkAny(pair.b)
  H(p): return p.f
  W(q): a=H(q); b=opaqueMay(q); returnPair(a,b)
  Latest modeled iteration: run-3; field limits are 1, 1, 2.

  All calls use one shared method context per method. Fields are counted.
  E/mx are empty; there are no aliases, ND rules, type filters or statics.
  The finite principal FLOW basis is explicit. ZERO is preserved. A record
  application cell is modeled as current Kotlin would compute it after only
  S8's new abstract-EXACT guards were relaxed. It is not a current-JVM bug.
  Existing bindX is not used for that cell: its old STAR/Universe row differs.
-/
namespace RestrictedInitialPolicy.ClosedExactReplay
open ApSpec ApSpec.AnyTaintEx ApSpec.Handoff ApSpec.Abs

def mq : Base := 10
def pair : Base := 11
def probe : Base := 12
def wq : Base := 20
def wa : Base := 21
def wb : Base := 22
def wr : Base := 23
def hp : Base := 30
def hr : Base := 31
def F : Acc := 7
def H : Acc := 8
def A : Acc := 9
def B : Acc := 10
def atom : ApSpec.Mark := 1

def flow (b : Base) (path : List Acc := []) (kind : Kind := .star Excl.empty) : PFact :=
  ⟨b, path, kind, .star⟩
def marked (b : Base) (path : List Acc) (kind : Kind) : PFact := ⟨b, path, kind, .conc atom⟩
def xf (fact : PFact) (demand : Bool := false) : XFact := ⟨⟨fact, demand⟩, Excl.empty⟩
def move (src dst : Base) (fromPath toPath : List Acc := []) : MicroEdge :=
  (flow src fromPath, flow dst toPath)
def step (edge : MicroEdge) (inputs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  inputs.flatMap fun input => (bindX input edge).facts
def limitAt (n : Nat) (inputs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  inputs.map (limitFX (fun _ => true) n)

def asInput (fact : PFact) (must : Bool := false) : Input :=
  ⟨fact.base, fact.path,
    (match fact.kind with | .exact => .exact | .star _ => .star | .any => .any),
    (match fact.mark with | .conc t => .full t | _ => .flow), must⟩
def asDemand (fact : PFact) : Demand :=
  ⟨fact.base, fact.path,
    (match fact.kind with | .exact => .exact | .star _ => .star | .any => .any),
    (match fact.mark with | .conc t => .full t | _ => .flow)⟩
def start (initial : Input) : XFact :=
  if initial.must then xf (toAp initial) else
    ⟨ApSpec.Run1CorrelatedConcreteInitials.selectedStart (toAp initial), Excl.empty⟩
def initials (d : Demand) (inputs : List XFact) (must : Bool := false) : List XFact :=
  inputs.flatMap fun input =>
    (emit d (asInput input.af.fact must)).toList.map start

abbrev Row := PFact × XFact
def zeroRow : Row := (zeroFact, xf zeroFact)
def analyze (initials : List XFact) (body : List XFact → List XFact) : List Row :=
  initials.flatMap fun initial => (body [initial]).map fun result => (initial.af.fact, result)
def applyRows (rows : List Row) (inputs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  inputs.flatMap fun actual => rows.flatMap fun row =>
    (applySummaryX actual row.1 Excl.empty row.2).facts
def normalNonzero (rows : List Row) : List Row :=
  rows.filter fun row => !row.2.af.demand && !(Nat.beq row.1.base zeroBase)
def nextDemand (rows : List Row) : List DemandEdge :=
  (rows.filter fun row => row.2.af.demand).map fun row => normDem ⟨row.2.af.fact, some row.1⟩
def c5 (d : DemandEdge) (row : Row) : Option Row :=
  if canEmit (asDemand d.din) (asInput row.1) then
    (restrictI row.1 row.2.af d).map fun result => (row.1, plain result)
  else none
def publish (demands : List DemandEdge) (rows : List Row) : List Row :=
  rows.flatMap fun row => demands.filterMap fun d => c5 d row
def admitted (demands : List DemandEdge) (inputs : List XFact) (must : Bool := false) : List XFact :=
  demands.flatMap fun d => initials (asDemand d.din) inputs must
def reverseRow (row : Row) : Row :=
  let edge := revEdge row.1 row.2.af.fact
  (edge.1, xf edge.2 row.2.af.demand)

def sourceEdge : MicroEdge := (zeroFact, marked mq [F, H] .any)
def sourceAll : List XFact := step sourceEdge [xf zeroFact]
def source1 : List XFact := limitAt 1 (sourceAll.map fun x => xf x.af.fact true)
def sinkSource : PFact := marked mq [F, H] .any
def sinkProbe : PFact := marked probe [] .exact
def sinkA : PFact := marked pair [A] .exact
def sinkB : PFact := marked pair [B] .any
def observed (facts : List XFact) (sink : PFact) : Bool :=
  facts.any fun fact => checkX zeroFact fact sink == .triggered

def hRead : MicroEdge := move hp hr [F] []
def hBind : MicroEdge := move mq hp [] []
def wBind : MicroEdge := move mq wq [] []
def whBind : MicroEdge := move wq hp [] []
def hBack : MicroEdge := move hr wa [] []
def probeBack : MicroEdge := move hr probe [] []
def wBack : MicroEdge := move wr pair [] []
def pairA : MicroEdge := move wa wr [] [A]
def pairB : MicroEdge := move wb wr [] [B]
def opaqueEdge : MicroEdge := (flow wq, flow wb [] .any)

/-- Repeated ZERO frames are not expanded in each principal nonzero basis.
    These declarations cannot turn ZERO into a helper/wrapper data result. -/
theorem zero_frames_do_not_add_a_hidden_return_cover :
    step (zeroFact, zeroFact) [xf zeroFact] = [xf zeroFact] ∧
    step hRead [xf zeroFact] = [] ∧
    step (revEdge hRead.1 hRead.2) [xf zeroFact] = [] ∧
    (applyEdgeXT (fun _ => false) (xf zeroFact) opaqueEdge).facts = [] ∧
    step pairA [xf zeroFact] = [] ∧ step pairB [xf zeroFact] = [] := by decide

def run1States (inputs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  inputs.map fun input => xf (flow input.af.fact.base)
def h1Initials : List XFact := run1States (step hBind source1)
def h1Rows : List Row :=
  [zeroRow] ++ analyze h1Initials (fun xs => xs ++ step hRead xs)
def w1Initials : List XFact := run1States (step wBind source1)
def viaH1 (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  step pairA (step hBack (applyRows h1Rows (step whBind xs)))
def viaOpaque (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  step pairB (xs.flatMap fun x => (applyEdgeXT (fun _ => false) x opaqueEdge).facts)
def w1Rows : List Row :=
  [zeroRow] ++ analyze w1Initials (fun xs => xs ++ viaH1 xs ++ viaOpaque xs)
def mainProbe1 : List XFact := step probeBack (applyRows h1Rows (step hBind source1))
def mainPair1 : List XFact := step wBack (applyRows w1Rows (step wBind source1))
def h2Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand h1Rows
def w2Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand w1Rows

theorem run1_reports_and_frontiers_are_derived :
    source1 = [xf (marked mq [F] .any) true] ∧
    observed source1 sinkSource = true ∧
    observed mainProbe1 sinkProbe = true ∧
    observed mainPair1 sinkA = true ∧ observed mainPair1 sinkB = true ∧
    h2Demands = [⟨flow hr [] .any, some (flow hp)⟩] ∧
    w2Demands = [⟨flow wr [A] .any, some (flow wq)⟩,
      ⟨flow wr [B] .any, some (flow wq)⟩] := by decide

def backwardSeed (sink : PFact) : List XFact := limitAt 1 [xf sink true]
def sourceHits2 : List XFact := step (revEdge sourceEdge.1 sourceEdge.2) (backwardSeed sinkSource)
def sourceSelected : Bool := sourceHits2.any fun hit => Nat.beq hit.af.fact.base zeroBase
def source3 : List XFact := if sourceSelected then limitAt 2 sourceAll else []
def directProbe2 : List XFact :=
  step (revEdge probeBack.1 probeBack.2) (backwardSeed sinkProbe)
def h2Initials : List XFact := admitted h2Demands directProbe2
def h2Raw : List Row := analyze h2Initials (step (revEdge hRead.1 hRead.2))
def h2Published : List Row := publish h2Demands h2Raw
def h2Records : List Row := normalNonzero h2Raw

theorem source_and_helper_record_are_constructed :
    sourceHits2 = [xf zeroFact true] ∧ sourceSelected = true ∧
    source3 = [xf (marked mq [F, H] .any)] ∧
    directProbe2 = [xf (marked hr [] .exact) true] ∧
    h2Initials = [xf (flow hr [] .exact)] ∧
    h2Raw = [(flow hr [] .exact, xf (flow hp [F] .exact))] ∧
    h2Published = h2Raw ∧ h2Records = h2Raw := by decide

def wActualA2 : List XFact := step (revEdge wBack.1 wBack.2) (backwardSeed sinkA)
def wActualB2 : List XFact := step (revEdge wBack.1 wBack.2) (backwardSeed sinkB)
def wAInitial2 : List XFact := admitted w2Demands wActualA2
def wBInitial2 : List XFact := admitted w2Demands wActualB2
def wStandingH2 (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  step (revEdge hBack.1 hBack.2) (step (revEdge pairA.1 pairA.2) xs)
def wBackwardA (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  step (revEdge whBind.1 whBind.2) (applyRows h2Published (wStandingH2 xs))
def wBackwardB (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let beforeOpaque := step (revEdge opaqueEdge.1 opaqueEdge.2) (step (revEdge pairB.1 pairB.2) xs)
  step (move wq wq [] []) beforeOpaque
def w2Raw : List Row := analyze wAInitial2 wBackwardA ++ analyze wBInitial2 wBackwardB
def w2Published : List Row := publish w2Demands w2Raw
def w2Records : List Row := normalNonzero w2Raw
def h3Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand h2Published
def w3Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand w2Published
def w3Initials : List XFact := admitted w3Demands (step wBind source3) true
def h3Added : List XFact := step whBind w3Initials
def h3Initials : List XFact := admitted h3Demands h3Added

theorem wrapper_backward_and_run3_input_are_constructed :
    wAInitial2 = [xf (flow wr [A] .exact)] ∧
    wBInitial2 = [xf (flow wr [B] .any) true] ∧
    wStandingH2 wAInitial2 = [xf (flow hr [] .exact)] ∧
    w2Raw = [(flow wr [A] .exact, xf (flow wq [F] .exact)),
      (flow wr [B] .any, xf (flow wq [] .any) true)] ∧
    w2Published = w2Raw ∧
    w2Records = [(flow wr [A] .exact, xf (flow wq [F] .exact))] ∧
    h3Demands = [] ∧
    w3Demands = [⟨flow wq [] .any, some (flow wr [B] .any)⟩] ∧
    w3Initials = [xf (flow wq [F])] ∧
    h3Added = [xf (flow hp [F])] ∧ h3Initials = [] := by decide

def h3Views : List Row := h2Records.map reverseRow
def availableHelperRows3 : List Row := normalNonzero h1Rows ++ h3Views
def normalStarReturnCover (row : Row) : Bool :=
  !row.2.af.demand && row.1 == flow hp [F] && row.2.af.fact == flow hr

theorem no_covering_helper_relation_is_assumed :
    h3Views = [(flow hp [F] .exact, xf (flow hr [] .exact))] ∧
    availableHelperRows3 = [(flow hp, xf (flow hp)),
      (flow hp [F] .exact, xf (flow hr [] .exact))] ∧
    (availableHelperRows3.any normalStarReturnCover) = false ∧
    satW (flow hp [F] .exact) (flow hp [F]) = true ∧
    satW (flow wq [F] .exact) (marked wq [F, H] .any) = false := by decide

/-- Same-path target-EXACT row of current Kotlin Reference.below/compose,
    after the abstract EXACT guards alone are relaxed. The legacy Lean
    STAR/Universe row is deliberately not substituted for this current cell. -/
def currentExactReplay (actual : XFact) (record : Row) : List XFact :=
  if Nat.beq actual.af.fact.base record.1.base &&
      actual.af.fact.path == record.1.path && record.1.kind == .exact &&
      record.2.af.fact.kind == .exact then
    match markGate record.1.mark actual.af.fact.mark with
    | .ok =>
      match markComp record.2.af.fact.mark actual.af.fact.mark with
      | none => []
      | some mark => [xf ⟨record.2.af.fact.base, record.2.af.fact.path, .exact, mark⟩
          (actual.af.demand || record.2.af.demand)]
    | _ => []
  else []

def replayHelper3 (inputs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  inputs.flatMap fun actual => h3Views.flatMap fun record =>
    if satW record.1 actual.af.fact then currentExactReplay actual record else []
def viaBadH3 (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  step pairA (step hBack (replayHelper3 (step whBind xs)))
def w3Raw : List Row :=
  analyze w3Initials (fun xs => xs ++ viaBadH3 xs ++ viaOpaque xs)
def w3Published : List Row := publish w3Demands w3Raw
def w3Records : List Row := normalNonzero w3Raw
def wrongRow : Row := (flow wq [F], xf (flow wr [A] .exact))

theorem false_normal_row_is_raw_and_persisted_but_not_published :
    viaBadH3 w3Initials = [xf (flow wr [A] .exact)] ∧
    w3Raw = [(flow wq [F], xf (flow wq [F])), wrongRow,
      (flow wq [F], xf (flow wr [B] .any) true)] ∧
    w3Published = [(flow wq [F], xf (flow wr [B] .any) true)] ∧
    wrongRow ∈ w3Records ∧ wrongRow ∉ w3Published := by decide

def concreteHPath : List XFact :=
  step pairA (step hBack (step hRead (step whBind [xf (marked wq [F, H] .exact)])))
def realInput : Loc := ⟨wq, [F, H], atom⟩
def falseOutput : Loc := ⟨wr, [A], atom⟩
def realReturnRelation : PFact := flow wr [A]

theorem concrete_program_keeps_the_suffix :
    concreteHPath = [xf (marked wr [A, H] .exact)] := by decide

theorem persisted_normal_has_a_false_pair :
    den wrongRow.1 wrongRow.2.af.fact realInput falseOutput ∧
    ¬ den wrongRow.1 realReturnRelation realInput falseOutput := by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨rfl, rfl, True.intro, rfl, True.intro, [H], [], rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, _, _, _, _, suffix, outSuffix, hs, ht, _, hc⟩
    have hs' : suffix = [H] := by simpa [wrongRow, flow, realInput] using hs.symm
    have ht' : outSuffix = [] := by simpa [realReturnRelation, flow, falseOutput] using ht.symm
    have same : outSuffix = suffix := hc.1
    rw [hs', ht'] at same
    cases same

/-- The other declared wrapper outputs cannot explain the false A-root pair:
    the argument frame has another base, and opaqueMay reaches B only. -/
theorem other_wrapper_paths_do_not_supply_false_a :
    ¬ den wrongRow.1 (flow wq [F]) realInput falseOutput ∧
    ¬ den wrongRow.1 (flow wr [B] .any) realInput falseOutput := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, outputBase, _⟩
    change (23 : Nat) = 20 at outputBase
    cases outputBase
  · rintro ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, outSuffix, _, outputPath, _, _⟩
    simp [falseOutput, flow, A, B] at outputPath

theorem false_normal_pair_is_absent_from_declared_wrapper_relation :
    den wrongRow.1 wrongRow.2.af.fact realInput falseOutput ∧
    ¬ (den wrongRow.1 (flow wq [F]) realInput falseOutput ∨
      den wrongRow.1 realReturnRelation realInput falseOutput ∨
      den wrongRow.1 (flow wr [B] .any) realInput falseOutput) := by
  refine ⟨persisted_normal_has_a_false_pair.1, ?_⟩
  intro alternative
  cases alternative with
  | inl frame => exact other_wrapper_paths_do_not_supply_false_a.1 frame
  | inr returns =>
    cases returns with
    | inl helper => exact persisted_normal_has_a_false_pair.2 helper
    | inr model => exact other_wrapper_paths_do_not_supply_false_a.2 model

def check : Bool :=
  sourceSelected && observed mainProbe1 sinkProbe &&
  (h3Demands == []) && (h3Initials == []) &&
  !(availableHelperRows3.any normalStarReturnCover) &&
  w3Raw.contains wrongRow && w3Records.contains wrongRow && !w3Published.contains wrongRow

theorem checked : check = true := by decide

#eval check

#print axioms wrapper_backward_and_run3_input_are_constructed
#print axioms no_covering_helper_relation_is_assumed

#print axioms persisted_normal_has_a_false_pair

end RestrictedInitialPolicy.ClosedExactReplay

/-
  Code-only replacement for the historical opaqueMay/returnPair trace above.

  source(q); sinkAny(q.f.h); pair=wrapper(q);
  sinkExact(pair.a); sinkAny(pair.b);

  helper(p) { return p.f; }
  box(q) { Box z=new Box(); z.value=q; return z; }
  wrapper(q) { Pair r=new Pair(); r.a=helper(q); r.b=box(q); return r; }

  Source rule only: source(q) has empty body and assigns T to q.f.h and all
  its descendants. Sink rules check the declared argument position. No pass
  rule supplies ANY. All code-generated data micro-edges have STAR tails.
  A field-limit cut supplies the run-1 B-route ANY. The source and local sink
  select run-3 source replay. No direct helper probe or shared-callsite
  assumption is needed: helper is called at one wrapper statement.

  Each instruction, call binding and summary application has its field cut.
  Field-write frames use cleanResX only on fresh/specific-field targets;
  no broad lhs fact occurs. The overwritten field is killed and a different
  known field survives. No claim about the old cleaner's broad-lhs row is
  used. This is a proposed-domain scalar certificate, not current JVM output.
  Latest modeled iteration: run-3, limits 1, 1, 2. No production mutation.
-/
namespace RestrictedInitialPolicy.CodeOnlyExactReplay
open ApSpec ApSpec.AnyTaintEx ApSpec.Handoff ApSpec.Abs
open RestrictedInitialPolicy.ClosedExactReplay
  (Row flow marked xf move step limitAt asInput asDemand start initials analyze
   applyRows normalNonzero nextDemand c5 publish admitted reverseRow zeroRow
   mq pair wq wa wr hp hr F H A B atom sourceAll source1 source3 sourceSelected
   sourceHits2 sinkSource sinkA sinkB observed backwardSeed wBind whBind hBack wBack
   currentExactReplay realInput falseOutput)

def r : Base := 24
def boxed : Base := 25
def boxArg : Base := 40
def boxLocal : Base := 41
def boxRet : Base := 42
def hLocal : Base := 32
def value : Acc := 11

def cut (L : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact := (limitAt L xs).eraseDups
def withoutBase (base : Base) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  xs.filter fun x => !(Nat.beq x.af.fact.base base)
def newObject (L base : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact := cut L (withoutBase base xs)
def assign (L : Nat) (src dst : Base) (fromPath toPath : List Acc)
    (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  cut L (withoutBase dst xs ++ step (move src dst fromPath toPath) xs)
def reverseAssign (L : Nat) (src dst : Base) (fromPath toPath : List Acc)
    (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  cut L (withoutBase dst xs ++ step (revEdge (move src dst fromPath toPath).1
    (move src dst fromPath toPath).2) xs)

def writeFrame (obj : Base) (field : Acc) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  xs.flatMap fun x => (cleanResX ⟨obj, [field], .atAndBelow, none⟩ x).facts
def writeField (L : Nat) (obj : Base) (field : Acc) (rhs : Base)
    (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  cut L (writeFrame obj field xs ++ step (move rhs obj [] [field]) xs)
def reverseWrite (L : Nat) (obj : Base) (field : Acc) (rhs : Base)
    (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  cut L (writeFrame obj field xs ++
    step (revEdge (move rhs obj [] [field]).1 (move rhs obj [] [field]).2) xs)
def knownWriteDomain (obj : Base) (xs : List XFact) : Bool :=
  xs.all fun x => !(Nat.beq x.af.fact.base obj) || !x.af.fact.path.isEmpty
def exports (arg ret : Base) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  xs.filter fun x => Nat.beq x.af.fact.base arg || Nat.beq x.af.fact.base ret ||
    Nat.beq x.af.fact.base zeroBase

def helperForward (L : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  exports hp hr (assign L hLocal hr [] [] (assign L hp hLocal [F] [] xs))
def helperBackward (L : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  exports hp hr (reverseAssign L hp hLocal [F] [] (reverseAssign L hLocal hr [] [] xs))
def boxBeforeWrite (L : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact := newObject L boxLocal xs
def boxForward (L : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  exports boxArg boxRet (assign L boxLocal boxRet [] []
    (writeField L boxLocal value boxArg (boxBeforeWrite L xs)))

def declaredCodeEdges : List MicroEdge := [
  move hp hLocal [F] [], move hLocal hr [] [],
  move boxArg boxLocal [] [value], move boxLocal boxRet [] [],
  move wq hp [] [], move hr wa [] [], move wq boxArg [] [],
  move boxRet boxed [] [], move wa r [] [A], move boxed r [] [B], move r wr [] []]

theorem every_code_data_edge_is_star_to_star :
    (declaredCodeEdges.all fun edge => edge.1.kind == .star Excl.empty &&
      edge.2.kind == .star Excl.empty) = true := by decide

def supplied (L : Nat) (arg target : Base) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  cut L (step (move arg target [] []) xs)
def callForward (L : Nat) (arg target ret lhs : Base) (rows : List Row)
    (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let joined := cut L (applyRows rows (supplied L arg target xs))
  cut L (withoutBase lhs xs ++ step (move ret lhs [] []) joined)
def callBackward (L : Nat) (arg target ret lhs : Base) (rows : List Row)
    (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let joined := cut L (applyRows rows (supplied L lhs ret xs))
  cut L (withoutBase lhs xs ++ step (move target arg [] []) joined)

def w1Initials : List XFact :=
  ClosedExactReplay.run1States (supplied 1 mq wq source1)
def h1Initials : List XFact :=
  ClosedExactReplay.run1States (supplied 1 wq hp (newObject 1 r w1Initials))
def h1Rows : List Row := [zeroRow] ++ analyze h1Initials (helperForward 1)
def w1AfterA : List XFact := writeField 1 r A wa
  (callForward 1 wq hp hr wa h1Rows (newObject 1 r w1Initials))
def box1Initials : List XFact :=
  ClosedExactReplay.run1States (supplied 1 wq boxArg w1AfterA)
def box1Rows : List Row := [zeroRow] ++ analyze box1Initials (boxForward 1)
def box1Records : List Row := normalNonzero box1Rows
def boxBackwardRows : List Row := box1Records.map reverseRow
def finishWrapper (L : Nat) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  exports wq wr (assign L r wr [] [] xs)
def w1AfterBox : List XFact := callForward 1 wq boxArg boxRet boxed box1Rows w1AfterA
def w1Body (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let afterA := writeField 1 r A wa
    (callForward 1 wq hp hr wa h1Rows (newObject 1 r xs))
  let afterBox := callForward 1 wq boxArg boxRet boxed box1Rows afterA
  finishWrapper 1 (writeField 1 r B boxed afterBox)
def w1Rows : List Row := [zeroRow] ++ analyze w1Initials w1Body
def mainPair1 : List XFact := cut 1 (step wBack (applyRows w1Rows (supplied 1 mq wq source1)))
def h2Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand h1Rows
def w2Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand w1Rows

theorem code_generated_box_record_and_run1_cut :
    box1Rows = [zeroRow, (flow boxArg, xf (flow boxArg)),
      (flow boxArg, xf (flow boxRet [value]))] ∧
    nextDemand box1Rows = [] ∧
    w1Rows = [zeroRow, (flow wq, xf (flow wq)),
      (flow wq, xf (flow wr [A] .any) true),
      (flow wq, xf (flow wr [B] .any) true)] ∧
    observed source1 sinkSource = true ∧
    observed mainPair1 sinkA = true ∧ observed mainPair1 sinkB = true := by decide

def wActualA2 : List XFact := cut 1 (step (revEdge wBack.1 wBack.2) (backwardSeed sinkA))
def wActualB2 : List XFact := cut 1 (step (revEdge wBack.1 wBack.2) (backwardSeed sinkB))
def wAInitial2 : List XFact := admitted w2Demands wActualA2
def wBInitial2 : List XFact := admitted w2Demands wActualB2
def backwardBeforeHelper (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let beforeReturn := reverseAssign 1 r wr [] [] xs
  let beforeBoxWrite := reverseWrite 1 r B boxed beforeReturn
  let beforeBoxCall := callBackward 1 wq boxArg boxRet boxed boxBackwardRows beforeBoxWrite
  reverseWrite 1 r A wa beforeBoxCall
def helperInput2 : List XFact := supplied 1 wa hr (backwardBeforeHelper wAInitial2)
def h2Initials : List XFact := admitted h2Demands helperInput2
def h2Raw : List Row := analyze h2Initials (helperBackward 1)
def h2Published : List Row := publish h2Demands h2Raw
def h2Records : List Row := normalNonzero h2Raw
def wBackward (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  exports wq wr (callBackward 1 wq hp hr wa h2Published (backwardBeforeHelper xs))
def w2Raw : List Row := analyze wAInitial2 wBackward ++ analyze wBInitial2 wBackward
def w2Published : List Row := publish w2Demands w2Raw
def w3Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand w2Published
def h3Demands : List DemandEdge := nextDemand h2Published
def w3Initials : List XFact := admitted w3Demands (supplied 2 mq wq source3) true
def h3Added : List XFact := supplied 2 wq hp w3Initials
def h3Initials : List XFact := admitted h3Demands h3Added

theorem ordinary_box_replay_builds_the_coarse_b_demand :
    boxBackwardRows = [(flow boxArg, xf (flow boxArg)),
      (flow boxRet [value], xf (flow boxArg))] ∧
    backwardBeforeHelper wBInitial2 = [xf (flow wq [] .any) true] ∧
    helperInput2 = [xf (flow hr [] .exact)] ∧
    h2Initials = [xf (flow hr [] .exact)] ∧
    h2Raw = [(flow hr [] .exact, xf (flow hp [F] .exact))] ∧
    h2Published = h2Raw ∧ h2Records = h2Raw ∧
    w2Raw = [(flow wr [A] .exact, xf (flow wq [F] .exact)),
      (flow wr [B] .any, xf (flow wq [] .any) true)] ∧
    w2Published = w2Raw ∧
    w3Demands = [⟨flow wq [] .any, some (flow wr [B] .any)⟩] ∧
    h3Demands = [] ∧ w3Initials = [xf (flow wq [F])] ∧
    h3Added = [xf (flow hp [F])] ∧ h3Initials = [] := by decide

def h3Views : List Row := h2Records.map reverseRow
def availableHelperRows3 : List Row := normalNonzero h1Rows ++ h3Views

theorem helper_inventory_has_no_hidden_cover :
    h1Rows = [zeroRow, (flow hp, xf (flow hp)),
      (flow hp, xf (flow hr [] .any) true)] ∧
    h3Views = [(flow hp [F] .exact, xf (flow hr [] .exact))] ∧
    availableHelperRows3 = [(flow hp, xf (flow hp)),
      (flow hp [F] .exact, xf (flow hr [] .exact))] ∧
    availableHelperRows3.any ClosedExactReplay.normalStarReturnCover = false := by decide

def replayArgumentIdentity (target : Base) (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let provided := supplied 1 wq target xs
  let native := (flow target, xf (flow target))
  supplied 1 target wq (cut 1 (applyRows [reverseRow native] provided))

/-- The call frame for q is an ordinary analyzed argument identity, not an
    unknown-effect pass rule. Adding its replay to pass-over gives no new fact. -/
theorem ordinary_argument_frames_support_the_backward_pass :
    (flow hp, xf (flow hp)) ∈ normalNonzero h1Rows ∧
    (flow boxArg, xf (flow boxArg)) ∈ box1Records ∧
    replayArgumentIdentity hp [xf (flow wq [] .any) true] =
      [xf (flow wq [] .any) true] ∧
    replayArgumentIdentity boxArg [xf (flow wq [] .any) true] =
      [xf (flow wq [] .any) true] := by decide

def callHelper3 (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let answers := (supplied 2 wq hp xs).flatMap fun actual => h3Views.flatMap fun record =>
    if satW record.1 actual.af.fact then currentExactReplay actual record else []
  cut 2 (withoutBase wa xs ++ step hBack (cut 2 answers))
def w3AfterA : List XFact := writeField 2 r A wa (callHelper3 (newObject 2 r w3Initials))
def w3AfterBox : List XFact := callForward 2 wq boxArg boxRet boxed box1Records w3AfterA
def w3BeforeReturn : List XFact := writeField 2 r B boxed w3AfterBox
def w3Body (xs : List XFact) : List XFact :=
  let afterA := writeField 2 r A wa (callHelper3 (newObject 2 r xs))
  let afterBox := callForward 2 wq boxArg boxRet boxed box1Records afterA
  finishWrapper 2 (writeField 2 r B boxed afterBox)
def w3Raw : List Row := analyze w3Initials w3Body
def w3Published : List Row := publish w3Demands w3Raw
def wrongRow : Row := (flow wq [F], xf (flow wr [A] .exact))

theorem code_only_zero_frames_generate_no_extra_data :
    helperForward 1 [xf zeroFact] = [xf zeroFact] ∧
    boxForward 1 [xf zeroFact] = [xf zeroFact] ∧
    w1Body [xf zeroFact] = [xf zeroFact] ∧
    w3Body [xf zeroFact] = [xf zeroFact] := by decide

theorem ordinary_writes_have_only_the_certified_frames :
    knownWriteDomain boxLocal (boxBeforeWrite 1 box1Initials) = true ∧
    knownWriteDomain r (callForward 1 wq hp hr wa h1Rows (newObject 1 r w1Initials)) = true ∧
    knownWriteDomain r w1AfterBox = true ∧
    knownWriteDomain r (callHelper3 (newObject 2 r w3Initials)) = true ∧
    knownWriteDomain r w3AfterBox = true ∧
    writeFrame r B [xf (flow r [A] .exact)] = [xf (flow r [A] .exact)] ∧
    writeFrame r B [xf (flow r [B] .exact)] = [] := by decide

theorem code_only_false_normal_is_persisted :
    w3Raw = [(flow wq [F], xf (flow wq [F])), wrongRow,
      (flow wq [F], xf (flow wr [B, value] .any) true)] ∧
    w3Published = [(flow wq [F], xf (flow wr [B, value] .any) true)] ∧
    wrongRow ∈ normalNonzero w3Raw ∧ wrongRow ∉ w3Published ∧
    (normalNonzero h1Rows ++ h3Views).any ClosedExactReplay.normalStarReturnCover = false := by decide

/-- With ordinary code, the helper/pair-A route still preserves H. Box can
    reach B.value only, so it cannot explain the false A-root pair. -/
def concreteHelperPath : List XFact :=
  let caller := newObject 2 r [xf (marked wq [F, H] .exact)]
  let actual := supplied 2 wq hp caller
  let returned := cut 2 (helperForward 2 actual)
  let afterCall := cut 2 (withoutBase wa caller ++ step hBack returned)
  assign 2 r wr [] [] (writeField 2 r A wa afterCall)

theorem concrete_code_keeps_h :
    (exports wq wr concreteHelperPath) =
      [xf (marked wq [F, H] .exact), xf (marked wr [A, H] .exact)] := by decide

theorem code_only_false_pair :
    den wrongRow.1 wrongRow.2.af.fact realInput falseOutput ∧
    ¬ den wrongRow.1 (flow wr [A]) realInput falseOutput ∧
    ¬ den wrongRow.1 (flow wr [B, value] .any) realInput falseOutput := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨rfl, rfl, True.intro, rfl, True.intro, [H], [], rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, _, _, _, _, suffix, outSuffix, hs, ht, _, hc⟩
    have hs' : suffix = [H] := by simpa [wrongRow, flow, ClosedExactReplay.realInput] using hs.symm
    have ht' : outSuffix = [] := by simpa [flow, ClosedExactReplay.falseOutput] using ht.symm
    have same : outSuffix = suffix := hc.1
    rw [hs', ht'] at same
    cases same
  · rintro ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, ht, _, _⟩
    simp [flow, ClosedExactReplay.falseOutput, A, B] at ht

def check : Bool :=
  sourceSelected && observed mainPair1 sinkA && observed mainPair1 sinkB &&
  (h3Initials == []) && w3Raw.contains wrongRow &&
  (normalNonzero w3Raw).contains wrongRow && !w3Published.contains wrongRow

theorem checked : check = true := by decide

#eval check
#print axioms code_generated_box_record_and_run1_cut
#print axioms every_code_data_edge_is_star_to_star
#print axioms ordinary_box_replay_builds_the_coarse_b_demand
